jobs.entry_prompt: Read AGENTS.md, config/authority.json, operations/stop.json and checkpoint.json from the actual campaign store. Acquire enforced director ownership. Reconcile pending effects and active workers. Advance a bounded batch of ready or due work; check output; save state. Do not recreate projects, roles or jobs. Stop on cancellation, expiry or cap. Quiet if unchanged; notify only meaningful results, failures, required input or agreed reports.
